subject.title: Portable vacuum gripper
subject.parent: 17/724,791 (US 2022/0331993 A1), abandoned March 2026 after rejection over US 11,413,727

citations.name: Rotem / GRABO
citations.title: Vacuum gripper
citations.cited_for: base element with peripheral openings; multi-layer elastically deformable vacuum seal element; gap/step conformity via a protruding portion pressed through an opening; air extraction in fluid communication with the cavity; pressure alarm and manual extraction mechanism; battery housed in the handle; hookable elements for a hoist
citations.weight: PRIMARY - the examiner applied this under 102(a)(2) to claims 1-3, 5-9, 11-12 and 14-15 of the parent
citations.note: This is the CLIENT'S OWN patent. The attorney did not have to search for it.

citations.name: Ristau / Schmalz
citations.title: Suction-type holding device
citations.cited_for: suction base of soft material (Shore hardness below 18) beneath a cover of inherently non-elastic solid material - the harder-over-softer two-portion seal; contact pressure transmitters elastically deformable in height; pressing means
citations.weight: SECONDARY - the examiner applied this with Document 1 under 103 to parent claim 4

citations.name: Preta
citations.title: Adjustable flexible vacuum gripper and method of gripping
citations.cited_for: two-walled inflatable structure with inner and outer walls defining a fluid-filled cavity, for conforming to irregular and non-symmetrical shapes

citations.name: Schmierer / Schunk
citations.title: Suction grip arm
citations.cited_for: microstructure of rods or pins (element 28) removably coupled at the periphery for pressing on the flexible suction body through openings

citations.name: Meyer
citations.title: Vacuum gripping device and method for operating a vacuum gripping device
citations.cited_for: pressure measurement device detecting actual pressure plus an electronic control unit controlling a control valve device - the controller, the alarm and the pressure gauge
citations.weight: SINGLE LIMITATION GROUP - the pressure/control claims

citations.name: Office action 17/724,791
citations.title: Non-Final Office Action mailed 2025-09-16 in U.S. App. 17/724,791
citations.inventor: Stephen A. Vu, Primary Examiner, Art Unit 3651
citations.cited_for: the examiner's own limitation-by-limitation findings in the PARENT application, applying Document 1 under 102(a)(2) and Document 1 + Document 2 under 103, plus a double-patenting rejection over US 12,115,659
citations.weight: STRATEGIC - not prior art in the ordinary sense; an office action from the parent's file wrapper
citations.note: NOT REACHABLE BY ANY PATENT-CORPUS SEARCH. It is a file-wrapper document, it is NPL, and finding it requires knowing the parent application exists and pulling its image file wrapper. Scored separately; counting it as a miss measures the wrong thing.
